guide.intro: HIIT involves hard work intervals separated by recovery. This list includes movements suited to those intervals, alongside functional strength, balance and core exercises that should be performed with controlled technique. Choose weights that allow the movement to stay consistent throughout the set.

intro_sources.title: NASM - HIIT programming: a trainer's guide

guide.image_rules: Show the same adult athlete in two separate panels: starting position and main movement or finishing position. Use additional panels for exercises with several stages. Keep the entire body and equipment visible, with small arrows indicating movement.

equipment.name: Light barbell
equipment.note: For the front squat, push press and thruster, these descriptions assume you can safely bring the light bar to the fronts of the shoulders before starting. Secure removable plates with collars.

equipment.name: Skillmill
equipment.note: These assume a Skillmill with a curved, non-motorised belt, adjustable resistance and front pushing handles. Stop the belt before changing your orientation or stepping off.

equipment.name: Mat and bodyweight
equipment.note: Use the mat for kneeling and lying exercises. Perform jumps and travelling movements on a stable, non-slip floor with enough clear space.

exercises.name: Two-handed kettlebell swing
exercises.summary: A powerful hip hinge that swings the bell to chest height. Works glutes, hamstrings and grip, and gets the heart rate up.
key_points: Hinge: push the hips back, don't squat down
Snap the hips forwards to float the bell to chest height
Arms stay long and relaxed; stand tall without leaning back
exercises.movement: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width, holding one kettlebell handle with both hands. Push the hips backwards, soften the knees and guide the bell between the upper thighs. Drive the hips forwards to stand tall, allowing the bell to swing to approximately chest height. Let it return between the thighs for the next repetition. The power comes from the hips; keep the arms long and avoid leaning backwards at the top.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the hips pushed backwards with the bell between the legs, followed by an upright position with the bell floating in front of the chest.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.summary: A squat holding the kettlebell at the chest. Builds the legs and glutes and teaches an upright squat.
key_points: Hold the bell close at chest height
Sit between the heels; knees follow the toes
Keep the chest up and heels down; drive up through the whole foot
exercises.movement: Stand with feet approximately shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly outwards. Hold the sides of the kettlebell handle with both hands at chest height, with the round body of the bell hanging below the hands. Bend the hips and knees to lower into a squat, keeping the heels grounded and knees following the direction of the toes. Push through the feet to return to standing.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing an upright start and a lowered squat, with the kettlebell held close to the chest in both positions.

exercises.name: Kettlebell suitcase deadlift
exercises.summary: A one-sided deadlift with the bell beside the foot. Works the legs and glutes while the core stops you leaning.
key_points: Bell beside the foot, hips back, back long
Stand up keeping the shoulders level; don't lean towards the bell
Lower along the same path, then switch sides
exercises.movement: Place one kettlebell beside the right foot. Stand with feet hip-width apart, push the hips backwards and bend the knees enough to grasp the handle with the right hand. Keep the back long and shoulders level as you stand, bringing the bell up beside the right thigh. Lower along the same path without twisting or leaning sideways. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the kettlebell outside one foot in the lowered position, then hanging beside the same thigh when standing.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet lateral lunge
exercises.summary: A side-step lunge holding the bell at the chest. Works the inner thighs, glutes and hip mobility.
key_points: Big step to the side; that knee bends, the other leg stays straight
Sit the hips back with both feet flat
Chest faces forwards; push off the bent leg to return
exercises.movement: Hold one kettlebell at chest height with both hands. Step widely to the right, bend the right knee and send the hips backwards while keeping the left leg relatively straight. Keep both feet grounded and the chest facing forwards. Push through the right foot to return to the centre, then repeat to the left.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing one knee bent, the opposite leg extended sideways and the kettlebell centred at the chest.

exercises.name: Kettlebell front-rack reverse lunge
exercises.summary: A backward lunge with the bell held at one shoulder. Builds the legs and challenges balance and core.
key_points: Bell racked at the shoulder, wrist straight, elbow by the ribs
Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor
Front foot stays planted; push through it to stand
exercises.movement: Hold a kettlebell in the right hand beside the right shoulder, with the bell resting against the outside of the forearm and the elbow close to the ribs. Step the right foot backwards and bend both knees, lowering the rear knee towards the floor. Keep the left foot planted. Push through the left foot to return to standing, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the bell beside the right shoulder, the left foot in front and the right knee lowered behind.

exercises.name: Kettlebell single-arm row
exercises.summary: A one-arm row from a hip hinge. Strengthens the upper back and arms.
key_points: Hinge with a flat back, free hand on the front thigh
Pull the elbow back towards the hip
Torso stays still: no twisting to lift the bell
exercises.movement: Place the left foot forwards and the right foot behind. Hinge forwards at the hips, rest the left hand on the left thigh and let a kettlebell hang from the right hand. Pull the right elbow backwards towards the hip, bringing the bell beside the lower ribs. Lower it under control while keeping the torso still. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the same hinged torso position in both panels: first with the working arm extended, then with the elbow drawn backwards.

exercises.name: Kettlebell single-arm floor press
exercises.summary: A one-arm press lying on the floor. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps with a safe range of movement.
key_points: Wrist straight, bell above the shoulder
Lower until the upper arm just touches the mat, elbow angled from the body
Press straight up and keep the shoulder blade on the floor
exercises.movement: Lie on your back on a mat with knees bent and feet flat. Hold a kettlebell in the right hand above the right shoulder, with the bell resting against the back of the forearm. Bend the elbow until the upper arm gently touches the mat, keeping it diagonally away from the torso. Press the bell upwards again. Keep the wrist straight and repeat on the other side.
exercises.image_cue: Three-quarter view from the feet, showing the upper arm resting on the mat and then the arm extended vertically above the shoulder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell suitcase carry
exercises.summary: Walking with one bell at your side. Builds grip, core and upright posture.
key_points: Tall posture, shoulders and hips level
Don't lean away from or towards the bell
Slow, steady steps; swap hands each length
exercises.movement: Stand tall with one kettlebell hanging from the right hand beside the thigh. Walk forwards using steady steps, keeping the shoulders and hips level. Maintain an upright torso as the single-sided weight challenges your balance. Keep the opposite hand empty and relaxed. Change the carrying hand for the next length.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the athlete walking with one kettlebell, level shoulders and the free arm clearly visible.

exercises.name: Kettlebell front-rack march
exercises.summary: Marching on the spot with a bell racked at the shoulder. Trains core control, balance and hip strength.
key_points: Bell racked at the shoulder and kept still
Lift each knee to hip height slowly
Stand tall and keep the hips level
exercises.movement: Hold one kettlebell beside the right shoulder in the front-rack position, with the wrist straight and elbow close to the ribs. Stand tall and slowly lift the left knee towards hip height. Lower the foot, then lift the right knee. Continue alternating while keeping the kettlebell still and the pelvis level. Change the holding arm between sets.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing one knee lifted, the supporting leg grounded and the bell held securely beside one shoulder.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling kettlebell overhead press
exercises.summary: A one-arm press from a half-kneeling position. Builds the shoulders while the core keeps you steady.
key_points: Back knee under the hip, front foot flat
Squeeze the glute of the back leg and brace
Press straight up without leaning back; lower slowly
exercises.movement: Kneel on the right knee on a mat, with the left foot planted in front and the left knee bent. Hold a kettlebell beside the right shoulder. Brace the abdomen and press the bell upwards until the hand is above the shoulder. Lower it slowly to the starting position, keeping the torso upright and lower back steady. Repeat on the other side.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the rear knee on the mat, the front foot planted and the working arm moving from shoulder height to overhead.

exercises.name: High-plank kettlebell drag
exercises.summary: Dragging a bell across under your body from a high plank. A tough core and shoulder stability exercise.
key_points: Feet wide, hips square to the floor
Reach under the body and drag the bell across
Don't let the hips twist or lift
exercises.movement: Begin in a high plank with palms on the floor beneath the shoulders and feet wider than hip-width. Place a kettlebell outside the right hand. Reach the left hand underneath the chest, grasp the handle and move the bell across to the outside of the left hand. Replace the palm on the floor, then change hands and reverse the movement. Keep the hips facing downwards.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing one palm supporting the body while the opposite hand reaches beneath the chest to move the kettlebell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell halo
exercises.summary: Circling a light bell around the head. Mobilises the shoulders and works the upper back and core.
key_points: Light bell held upside down at the chest
Circle it close around the head, shoulder to shoulder
Keep the body still; change direction each set
exercises.movement: Stand upright, holding a light kettlebell by the sides of its handle in front of the chest. Guide the bell over the right shoulder, around the back of the head and over the left shoulder, returning it to the chest. Keep the trunk still and use a smooth, comfortable circle. Reverse direction. Perform this as a controlled movement.
exercises.image_cue: Three panels showing the bell at the chest, beside one side of the head and behind the head, with a curved directional arrow.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
exercises.summary: Bringing the bell from between the legs to the shoulder in one smooth move. Powerful hips with a soft catch.
key_points: Hinge to start, bell close to the body
Drive the hips; elbow stays near the ribs
Let the bell roll softly onto the forearm: don't flip it
exercises.movement: Stand with the kettlebell between the feet. Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the handle with one hand. Drive the hips forwards to stand, keeping the kettlebell close to the body, and guide it up so the elbow stays near the ribs and the bell rolls softly around the wrist into the rack position at the front of the shoulder. Lower it back between the legs with a hinge and repeat, then change hands.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the hinge with the kettlebell between the legs, then standing tall with it racked at the front of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell overhead press
exercises.summary: A standing one-arm press overhead. Builds the shoulders, arms and core.
key_points: Bell racked at the shoulder, wrist straight
Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes
Press straight up without leaning back; lower slowly
exercises.movement: Stand tall with a kettlebell held in the rack position at the front of one shoulder, wrist straight and elbow close to the ribs. Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes, then press the bell straight up until the arm is straight beside the ear. Lower it back to the shoulder with control. Complete the set, then change arms.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing the kettlebell racked at the shoulder, then pressed overhead with a straight arm and the body upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian deadlift
exercises.summary: A hip hinge holding one bell in both hands. Works the hamstrings, glutes and back.
key_points: Soft knees; push the hips back
Bell stays close to the legs
Flat back; stand tall by squeezing the glutes
exercises.movement: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of the thighs. Soften the knees and push the hips back, lowering the bell close to the legs until you feel a stretch in the back of the thighs with a flat back. Drive the hips forwards to stand tall.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing a tall start with the kettlebell at the thighs, then the hip hinge with the bell below the knees and the back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster
exercises.summary: A squat straight into an overhead press. A full-body move for legs, shoulders and fitness.
key_points: Squat with the heels down and chest up
Use the drive out of the squat to press overhead
Finish tall with arms straight, then lower to the shoulders
exercises.movement: Stand with a dumbbell beside each shoulder, palms facing inwards. Lower into a squat with the heels grounded. Push through the feet to stand, continuing the upward movement into an overhead press. Finish tall with both weights above the shoulders. Lower the dumbbells to shoulder height before beginning the next squat.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bottom of the squat with weights at the shoulders, followed by the standing overhead position.

sources.title: ACE - Total-body workout, including the dumbbell thruster

exercises.name: Dumbbell walking lunge
exercises.summary: Lunging forwards step after step with dumbbells at your sides. Builds the legs, glutes and balance.
key_points: Long step; lower the back knee towards the floor
Front knee over the ankle, torso upright
Weights stay still at your sides
exercises.movement: Stand with one dumbbell hanging at each side. Take a controlled step forwards and bend both knees, lowering the rear knee towards the floor. Keep the front foot flat and torso upright. Push through the front foot, bring the rear leg forwards and step into the next lunge. Keep the weights steady beside the hips.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing a long walking stride, both knees bent and one dumbbell hanging beside each hip.

exercises.name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.summary: A one-leg hip hinge holding a dumbbell. Works the hamstrings and glutes and trains balance.
key_points: Soft standing knee, hips square to the floor
Hinge forwards as the back leg reaches behind
Keep the back long; lower only as far as you control
exercises.movement: Stand on the left leg with a slight bend in the knee, holding one dumbbell in the right hand. Hinge forwards at the left hip while extending the right leg behind you. Let the weight lower towards the left shin, keeping the hips facing the floor and the back long. Return to standing under control, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the torso leaning forwards, the rear leg extending backwards and the dumbbell hanging near the standing leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell farmer's carry
exercises.summary: Walking with a heavy dumbbell in each hand. Builds grip, shoulders, core and posture.
key_points: Stand tall with shoulders back and level
Tight grip, weights clear of the legs
Short, steady steps; turn with small steps
exercises.movement: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight beside the body and palms facing the thighs. Walk forwards with controlled steps, keeping the torso upright, shoulders level and weights clear of the legs. Maintain a firm grip. When turning, use several small steps before walking back.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the athlete walking with two equally sized dumbbells hanging beside the thighs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell renegade row - without a push-up
exercises.summary: Rowing one dumbbell at a time from a high plank. Works the back, arms and core.
key_points: Feet wide for balance, hands under the shoulders
Row one dumbbell to the ribs
Keep the hips level: minimise twisting
exercises.movement: Use stable, flat-sided dumbbells. Grip their handles in a high-plank position, with the weights beneath the shoulders and feet wider than the hips. Pull the right dumbbell towards the lower ribs while the left remains grounded. Lower it carefully, then change arms. Keep the hips level and minimise rotation throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing one dumbbell grounded beneath the shoulder and the other raised beside the ribs, with both legs extended.

exercises.name: Dumbbell burpee deadlift
exercises.summary: A burpee that finishes with a dumbbell deadlift. A full-body conditioning move.
key_points: Hinge or squat to set the dumbbells down
Step back to a plank, then step in again
Brace and stand up with a flat back
exercises.movement: Start standing with two dumbbells at your sides. Bend the hips and knees to place them on the floor beside the feet. Put both palms on the floor between the weights and step the feet backwards into a plank. Step forwards again, regrip the dumbbells, brace the torso and stand up. The weights stay grounded during the plank.
exercises.image_cue: Four panels: standing with weights; crouching with palms on the floor; high plank between the weights; standing with weights again.

exercises.name: Dumbbell glute bridge
exercises.summary: Lifting the hips with a dumbbell across them. Strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
key_points: Dumbbell across the hips, feet flat
Push through the heels to lift the hips
Squeeze the glutes at the top; don't over-arch the back
exercises.movement: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Place one dumbbell horizontally across the front of the hips and secure it with both hands. Press through the feet and lift the hips until the shoulders, hips and knees form a sloping line. Lower slowly, keeping the movement at the hips and avoiding an excessive arch through the lower back.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the hips near the mat, followed by the raised bridge, with the dumbbell held across the pelvis.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor pullover
exercises.summary: Lowering a dumbbell behind the head while lying down. Works the lats, chest and core.
key_points: Hold one end of a light dumbbell with both hands
Lower behind the head with soft elbows, ribs down
Stop where the shoulders are comfortable
exercises.movement: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet flat. Hold one light, fixed-weight dumbbell above the chest with both hands securely cupping one end. Maintain a slight bend in the elbows as you lower the arms towards the floor behind the head. Stop within a comfortable shoulder range, then bring the weight back above the chest while keeping the ribs down.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the dumbbell above the chest and then behind the head, with an arrow tracing the curved movement of the arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press
exercises.summary: Pressing two dumbbells overhead from the shoulders. Builds the shoulders and arms with core control.
key_points: Dumbbells at the shoulders, stomach braced
Press both straight up until the arms are straight
Don't lean back; lower slowly to the shoulders
exercises.movement: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell beside each shoulder, palms facing forwards or inwards. Brace the stomach and press both dumbbells overhead until the arms are straight. Lower them slowly back to the shoulders. Keep the knees softly unlocked and the torso upright without leaning back. You can also press one arm at a time.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing dumbbells at the shoulders, then both pressed overhead with straight arms and the body upright.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over reverse fly
exercises.summary: Opening the arms wide while bent over. Strengthens the rear shoulders and upper back for good posture.
key_points: Hinge forwards with a flat back and soft knees
Open the arms wide with a small bend in the elbows
Stay bent over: don't stand up to lift
exercises.movement: Stand with knees slightly bent and hinge forwards at the hips. Let two light dumbbells hang beneath the chest, palms facing each other. Keep a small bend in the elbows and open the arms out to the sides until the upper arms are approximately level with the torso. Lower slowly while maintaining the same back position.
exercises.image_cue: Rear three-quarter view showing the hinged torso and arms opening outwards into a broad "T" shape.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge to knee drive
exercises.summary: A backward lunge that finishes with a knee lift. Works the legs, glutes and balance.
key_points: Step back into a lunge, front foot planted
Drive up and lift the back knee to hip height
Balance for a moment before the next rep
exercises.movement: Hold a dumbbell beside each thigh. Step the right foot backwards and lower into a lunge, keeping the left foot planted. Push through the left foot to stand, bringing the right knee forwards and upwards towards hip height. Balance briefly, then lower the foot to reset. Repeat on the other side. Keep this version grounded, without a jump.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the right leg behind in the lunge, then the same right knee lifted forwards while the athlete balances on the left leg.

exercises.name: Dumbbell diagonal chop
exercises.summary: A diagonal chop across the body with one dumbbell. Works the core, especially the obliques.
key_points: Start at one shoulder, finish outside the opposite knee
Turn the hips and shoulders together; pivot the feet
Control the weight both ways
exercises.movement: Hold one light dumbbell securely in both hands near the right shoulder. Guide it diagonally across the body towards the outside of the left thigh, slightly bending the knees. Turn the hips and shoulders together and allow the feet to pivot. Return along the same diagonal path, then change sides. Use controlled movement throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a high starting position beside one shoulder and a low finishing position beside the opposite thigh, joined by a diagonal arrow.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian twist
exercises.summary: Twisting the chest side to side while seated and leaning back. Works the core and obliques.
key_points: Lean back with a long spine and braced stomach
Turn the chest, not just the arms
Keep the heels down to make it easier
exercises.movement: Sit on the mat with the knees bent and hold a light dumbbell (or one in each hand) close to the chest. Lean back slightly with a long spine and brace the stomach; keep the heels down, or lift them to make it harder. Rotate the chest and dumbbell to one side, return to the middle and rotate to the other side. Move with control and turn from the ribs rather than just swinging the arms.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the seated lean-back position with the dumbbell held at the chest, rotated to one side.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
exercises.summary: Rising onto the toes holding dumbbells. Strengthens the calves and ankles.
key_points: Stand tall, dumbbells by the sides
Rise high onto the balls of the feet and pause
Lower the heels slowly
exercises.movement: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand by the sides. Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as you can, pause briefly, then lower the heels slowly to the floor. Keep the body tall, the knees straight but not locked and the weight over the big toes.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the heels down with dumbbells by the sides, then raised high onto the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell concentration curl
exercises.summary: A seated one-arm curl with the elbow braced on the thigh. Isolates the biceps.
key_points: Back of the upper arm against the inner thigh
Curl to the shoulder without moving the upper arm
Lower slowly to a straight arm
exercises.movement: Sit on the end of a bench with the feet wide. Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the back of that upper arm against the inside of the thigh, with the other hand on the opposite knee. Curl the dumbbell towards the shoulder without moving the upper arm, squeeze, then lower slowly until the arm is straight. Complete the set, then change arms.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the seated position with the working arm straight against the inner thigh, then the dumbbell curled to the shoulder.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
exercises.summary: A side-step lunge holding dumbbells at the chest. Works the inner thighs, glutes and hip mobility.
key_points: Dumbbells held close at the chest
Wide step to the side; sit the hips back, other leg straight
Chest lifted; push off the bent leg to return
exercises.movement: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at the chest, close to the body. Take a wide step to one side, push the hips back and bend that knee while keeping the other leg straight and both feet flat. Keep the chest lifted and the dumbbells close. Push through the bent leg to return to the start and alternate sides.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing a tall start with dumbbells held at the chest, then a wide side step with one knee bent and the other leg straight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell sumo squat
exercises.summary: A wide-stance squat holding one dumbbell between the legs. Works the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
key_points: Wide stance, toes turned out
Push the knees out over the toes as you lower
Chest up; drive through the heels to stand
exercises.movement: Stand with the feet wider than the shoulders and the toes turned out. Hold one dumbbell vertically by one end with both hands, letting it hang between the legs. Push the hips back and bend the knees to lower, keeping the chest lifted and the knees pushing out over the toes. Drive through the heels to stand tall.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a wide stance with one dumbbell hanging between the legs, then the bottom of the squat with the knees out over the toes.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.summary: Pressing two dumbbells up while lying on the floor. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
key_points: Upper arms at about 45 degrees from the body
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor
Press up over the chest; keep the wrists straight
exercises.movement: Lie on the mat with the knees bent and the feet flat, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the upper arms on the floor at about 45 degrees from the body, with the dumbbells above the chest. Press both dumbbells up until the arms are straight above the shoulders, then lower slowly until the upper arms touch the floor.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the upper arms resting on the floor with the dumbbells at the chest, then pressed up with straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
exercises.summary: Curling dumbbells up to the shoulders. Builds the biceps and forearms.
key_points: Elbows stay by the sides
Curl up, squeeze, then lower slowly
No swinging: keep the body still
exercises.movement: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by the sides and palms facing forwards. Keeping the elbows close to the body, curl the dumbbells up towards the shoulders. Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until the arms are straight. Avoid swinging the body to lift the weight.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the arms straight with dumbbells by the thighs, then curled up to the shoulders with the elbows by the sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raise
exercises.summary: Raising dumbbells forwards to shoulder height. Works the front of the shoulders.
key_points: Light dumbbells, small bend in the elbows
Raise to shoulder height only
Lower slowly; don't rock the body
exercises.movement: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing the body. Brace the stomach and, with a small bend in the elbows, raise both dumbbells forwards to shoulder height. Pause, then lower slowly. Keep the body still and use light dumbbells.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the dumbbells in front of the thighs, then raised forwards to shoulder height with nearly straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.summary: Rowing two dumbbells to the ribs from a hip hinge. Strengthens the upper back and arms.
key_points: Hinge with a flat back, chest well forwards
Pull the dumbbells to the lower ribs, elbows close
Squeeze the shoulder blades; hold the hinge
exercises.movement: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, soften the knees and hinge forwards at the hips until the chest is well forwards, with a flat back and the dumbbells hanging below the shoulders. Pull the dumbbells towards the lower ribs, keeping the elbows close to the body and squeezing the shoulder blades together. Lower with control and keep the hinge throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the hip hinge with dumbbells hanging, then pulled up towards the ribs with the elbows behind the body.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.summary: Raising dumbbells out to the sides. Works the side of the shoulders.
key_points: Light dumbbells, small bend in the elbows
Raise out to the sides to shoulder height
Keep the shoulders down away from the ears
exercises.movement: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand by the sides, palms facing in. With a small bend in the elbows, raise the arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height. Pause, then lower slowly. Keep the shoulders down away from the ears and use light dumbbells.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing the dumbbells by the sides, then raised out to shoulder height with nearly straight arms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell push press
exercises.summary: A short knee dip that drives two dumbbells overhead. Powerful legs and strong shoulders.
key_points: Dumbbells at the shoulders, torso tall
Short dip at the knees, then drive up hard
Finish with straight arms; lower to the shoulders with control
exercises.movement: Stand with the feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell at each shoulder. Make a short, quick dip by bending the knees with the torso upright, then straighten the legs powerfully and use that drive to press both dumbbells overhead. Finish tall with straight arms, then lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders with control.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the knee dip with dumbbells at the shoulders, then standing tall with both dumbbells pressed overhead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.summary: A hip hinge lowering two dumbbells down the legs. Works the hamstrings, glutes and back.
key_points: Soft knees; push the hips back
Dumbbells slide close down the thighs
Flat back; stand tall by squeezing the glutes
exercises.movement: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs. Soften the knees and push the hips back, lowering the dumbbells close to the legs until you feel a stretch in the back of the thighs, keeping the back flat. Drive the hips forwards to stand tall.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing a tall start with dumbbells at the thighs, then the hip hinge with the dumbbells lowered past the knees and the back flat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell man maker
exercises.summary: A plank row on each side, then a squat clean and press. A tough full-body move.
key_points: Plank on the dumbbells, feet wide; row one side then the other
Step or jump the feet in, then clean the dumbbells to the shoulders
Stand and press overhead; use light dumbbells
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor, with the feet wide. Row one dumbbell to the ribs, lower it, then row the other, keeping the hips level. Step or jump the feet in towards the hands, bring the dumbbells up to the shoulders, stand and press them overhead. Lower them to the floor and repeat. Use flat-sided, light dumbbells.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing a plank on the dumbbells with one dumbbell rowed to the ribs, then standing tall with both dumbbells pressed overhead.

exercises.name: Light-barbell deadlift
exercises.summary: Lifting the bar from the floor to standing. Builds the whole back of the body: glutes, hamstrings and back.
key_points: Bar close to the shins, hips back, back flat
Brace, then push the floor away to stand
Bar stays close to the legs all the way
exercises.movement: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and the bar close to the shins. Bend at the hips and knees, taking an overhand grip just outside the legs. Brace the torso and push through the feet to stand, keeping the bar close to the body. Finish upright, then lower under control. Use a starting height that allows the back to remain steady.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bar close to the shins at the start and against the thighs at the standing finish.

exercises.name: Light-barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.summary: A hip hinge lowering the bar down the thighs. Works the hamstrings and glutes.
key_points: Soft knees; push the hips back
Bar slides close down the thighs
Lower only as far as the back stays flat
exercises.movement: Begin standing with the bar in front of the thighs, arms straight and hands just outside the hips. Soften the knees, push the hips backwards and let the bar travel close to the legs. Lower only as far as you can maintain a steady back position. Bring the hips forwards to stand again, keeping the knees slightly bent during the lowering phase.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing an upright start and a clear hip hinge, with the bar below the knees and the hips pushed backwards.

exercises.name: Light-barbell bent-over row
exercises.summary: Rowing the bar to the stomach from a hip hinge. Strengthens the upper back and arms.
key_points: Hinge with soft knees and a flat back
Pull the bar to the upper stomach, elbows back
Keep the torso angle the same every rep
exercises.movement: Hold the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width. Soften the knees and hinge forwards, allowing the bar to hang beneath the shoulders. Pull it towards the upper abdomen by drawing both elbows backwards. Lower to straight arms while keeping the torso at the same angle throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bar hanging below the shoulders, then drawn towards the torso, with the back position unchanged.

exercises.name: Light-barbell front squat
exercises.summary: A squat with the bar on the front of the shoulders. Builds the legs and an upright torso.
key_points: Elbows high, bar on the front of the shoulders
Squat with the chest up and heels down
Drive up through the middle of the foot
exercises.movement: Support the bar across the fronts of the shoulders, with hands just outside shoulder-width and elbows pointing forwards. Stand with feet around shoulder-width apart. Bend the hips and knees to lower into a squat, keeping the chest lifted and heels grounded. Push through the feet to stand, keeping the bar balanced over the middle of the feet.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bar resting on the shoulders, elbows pointing forwards and the athlete in the lowered squat position.

exercises.name: Light-barbell push press
exercises.summary: A short knee dip that drives the bar overhead. Powerful legs and strong shoulders.
key_points: Short dip at the knees, torso tall
Drive with the legs, then finish with the arms
Lower to the shoulders with control
exercises.movement: Begin upright with the bar across the fronts of the shoulders. Make a shallow knee dip while keeping the torso tall. Straighten the legs to drive the bar upwards, then extend the arms to finish overhead. Lower the bar to the shoulders under control. The leg movement is a short dip and drive.
exercises.image_cue: Two side-view panels: a shallow knee bend with the bar at the shoulders, followed by a tall position with the bar overhead.

exercises.name: Light-barbell thruster
exercises.summary: A front squat straight into an overhead press. A full-body move for legs, shoulders and fitness.
key_points: Front squat with elbows high and heels down
Drive up and press overhead in one movement
Finish tall with the bar over the middle of the feet
exercises.movement: Hold the bar across the fronts of the shoulders and lower into a front squat. Push through the feet to rise, using the upward drive to continue into an overhead press. Finish with the legs and arms extended and the bar balanced above the body. Return the bar to the shoulders before starting the next squat.
exercises.image_cue: Three panels showing the front squat, the rising transition and the standing overhead finish.

sources.title: ACE - Front squat to overhead press

exercises.name: Light-barbell back squat
exercises.summary: A squat with the bar across the upper back. Builds the legs and glutes.
key_points: Bar on the upper back, not the neck
Hips back, knees over the toes, chest up
Use a rack to take and return the bar
exercises.movement: Take the bar from a rack set at about chest height and rest it across the upper back, not the neck, with the hands just outside the shoulders. Step back, place the feet about shoulder-width apart and brace. Push the hips back and bend the knees to lower, keeping the chest lifted and the knees tracking over the toes. Drive through the whole foot to stand, then return the bar to the rack.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the bar across the upper back, a tall start and the bottom of the squat with the knees over the toes.

exercises.name: Light-barbell overhead press
exercises.summary: Pressing the bar overhead with straight legs. Builds the shoulders, arms and core.
key_points: Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes
Press straight up, moving the head out of the way
Legs stay straight: no dipping
exercises.movement: Start standing with the bar resting across the fronts of the shoulders and the hands just outside shoulder width. Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes. Press the bar straight up, moving the head back slightly to let it pass, then bring the head through once the bar is above the forehead. Finish with the arms straight and the bar over the middle of the feet, then lower it back to the shoulders with control. Keep the legs straight throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing the bar at the shoulders, then pressed overhead with straight arms and the body upright.

exercises.name: Light-barbell reverse lunge
exercises.summary: A backward lunge with the bar on the upper back. Works the legs, glutes and balance.
key_points: Bar on the upper back, taken from a rack
Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor
Torso upright; push through the front heel
exercises.movement: Rest the bar across the upper back, taken from a rack set at about chest height. Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and brace. Step one foot back and lower until the back knee is just above the floor, keeping the front knee over the ankle and the chest upright. Push through the front heel to return to standing and alternate legs.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the bar across the upper back and the bottom of the reverse lunge, with the torso upright and the back knee just above the floor.

exercises.name: Light-barbell hang clean
exercises.summary: A fast pull from the thighs, catching the bar on the shoulders. Builds power; learn it light.
key_points: Start at mid-thigh with straight arms
Drive the hips and legs, keeping the bar close
Fast elbows to catch on the shoulders; learn it light
exercises.movement: Stand holding the bar at mid-thigh with the hands just outside the thighs and the arms straight. Hinge slightly at the hips, then drive the hips and legs to stand tall quickly, letting the bar travel close to the body. Pull yourself under the bar, turning the elbows quickly forwards to catch it on the fronts of the shoulders in a partial squat, then stand tall. Lower the bar to the thighs with control. Learn this with a very light bar and an experienced coach before adding speed.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the bar at mid-thigh, then caught on the fronts of the shoulders with the elbows high and the knees slightly bent.

exercises.name: Skillmill forward run
exercises.summary: Running on the curved, self-powered belt. Cardio that builds leg drive.
key_points: Start walking, then build to a run
Stand tall, head in line with the body
Opposite arm swings with each knee
exercises.movement: Face forwards and begin walking before building to a controlled run. Alternate the legs, pushing the belt backwards with each foot contact. Swing the opposite arm forwards as each knee advances, keeping the torso tall and head aligned with the body.
exercises.image_cue: Full side view showing the curved belt, one knee moving forwards, the opposite leg extending behind and both arms clear of the rails.

exercises.name: Skillmill supported high-knee drill
exercises.summary: High-knee running drill while holding the rails. Cardio and running technique.
key_points: Hold the rails for support
Lift the knees towards hip height
Short, controlled steps at a pace you can balance
exercises.movement: Face forwards and hold the fixed side rails for support. Lift one knee towards hip height while the other foot pushes the belt backwards. Alternate with short, controlled steps, maintaining an upright torso. Begin at a pace that allows you to stay balanced.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing both hands on the rails, one knee raised in front and the opposite foot contacting the belt.

exercises.name: Skillmill high sled push
exercises.summary: Pushing the belt from the high handles like a sled. Works the legs and fitness.
key_points: Hands on the high handles, resistance you can manage
Lean in with a braced, long back
Drive each foot down and back
exercises.movement: Select manageable resistance and place both hands on the higher front pushing handles. Lean forwards with a braced torso and long spine. Drive one foot down and backwards against the belt, then alternate legs. Keep the hands fixed on the handles.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the higher hand position, a moderate forward lean and alternating leg drive.

exercises.name: Skillmill low sled push
exercises.summary: A deeper, lower sled push from the low handles. Hard work for the legs and lungs.
key_points: Hands on the low handles
Deeper forward lean, back long
Short, powerful pushes with steady shoulders
exercises.movement: Hold the lower front pushing handles with suitable resistance selected. Lower the torso into a stronger forward lean while keeping the back long. Alternate short, powerful backward pushes against the belt, maintaining stable shoulders and fixed hands. Technogym's dual handlebar supports both high and low pushing positions.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the hands on the lower grips and the torso positioned lower than in the high sled push.

exercises.name: Skillmill lateral shuffle - experienced users
exercises.summary: Sideways shuffle on a slow belt, for experienced users. Agility and side-to-side strength.
key_points: Experienced users only; start with the belt stopped
Knees bent, feet never cross
Slow and controlled; stop before changing sides
exercises.movement: With the belt stopped, turn sideways and slightly bend the knees. At a slow, controlled pace, step sideways towards the front of the belt, then bring the trailing foot towards the lead foot without crossing the feet. Stop before changing sides. Technogym includes sideways movement and high-knee drills among its Skillmill agility exercises.
exercises.image_cue: Three-quarter view showing the torso facing the side of the machine, knees slightly bent and feet separated on the belt.

exercises.name: SkiErg double-pole pull
exercises.summary: Pulling both handles down together on the SkiErg. Works the back, arms, core and fitness.
key_points: Start with handles above eye level, elbows bent
Hinge and pull both handles down to the thighs
Stand tall to recover smoothly
exercises.movement: Face the machine with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft and handles slightly above eye level. Begin with elbows bent. Engage the trunk and hinge forwards at the hips as both handles travel down towards the thighs. Allow a small knee bend, then stand and return the handles smoothly. Keep a slight bend in the elbows at the finish.
exercises.image_cue: Side-view panels showing the upright start and hinged finish, with both handles beside the thighs and cords extending to the overhead pulleys.

exercises.name: SkiErg alternating-arm pull
exercises.summary: Pulling one handle at a time on the SkiErg. Works the back, arms and core in a steady rhythm.
key_points: Soft knees, torso controlled
Pull one handle down as the other rises
Keep a slight bend in the pulling elbow
exercises.movement: Face the machine with knees softly bent. Start with one handle raised near head height and the other beside the thigh. Pull the raised handle down while allowing the opposite handle to return upwards. Continue alternating, keeping a slight bend in the pulling elbow and the torso controlled. Use a SkiErg with independently moving handles.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing one handle high, the other low and the two cords clearly separated.

exercises.name: SkiErg staggered-stance double pull
exercises.summary: A double-pole pull with one foot in front. Adds a balance challenge to the SkiErg.
key_points: One foot slightly in front
Hinge and pull both handles to the thighs
Swap the front foot each set
exercises.movement: Stand facing the machine with one foot a short step ahead of the other, keeping some width between the feet. Begin with both handles raised and elbows bent. Hinge forwards and pull both handles towards the thighs, then recover upright. Keep the feet planted and change the leading foot between sets. This is a stance variation of the double-pole pull.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the staggered feet and both handles moving down together, with a small knee bend.

sources.title: Concept2 Singapore - SkiErg technique and stance variations

exercises.name: Squat jump
exercises.summary: A squat into a jump straight up. Builds leg power and gets the heart rate up.
key_points: Squat down, swing the arms
Jump straight up
Land softly with bent knees and reset
exercises.movement: Stand with feet around shoulder-width apart. Bend the hips and knees into a comfortable squat, then swing the arms forwards and extend the legs to jump vertically. Land on both feet, bending the hips and knees to absorb the landing. Regain control before repeating.
exercises.image_cue: Three side-view panels showing the squat, the airborne position and the landing with knees bent.

exercises.name: Lateral skater bound
exercises.summary: Bounding side to side from one leg to the other. Builds leg power, balance and agility.
key_points: Push off sideways from one leg
Land softly on the other foot with a bent knee
Trailing leg behind; use the arms to balance
exercises.movement: Start balanced on the left leg with the knee slightly bent. Push sideways and land on the right foot, bending the right hip and knee. Allow the left leg to trail diagonally behind without bearing weight. Push back towards the left, using the arms to help balance and controlling each landing.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing alternating left-foot and right-foot landings, with the free leg trailing behind the supporting leg.

exercises.name: Burpee without a push-up
exercises.summary: Down to a plank and back up into a small jump. A full-body conditioning move.
key_points: Hands down, step or jump back to a plank
Straight arms in the plank, hips level
Feet in, stand and make a small jump; land soft
exercises.movement: Start standing. Bend the hips and knees and place both hands on the floor. Step or jump the feet backwards into a high plank. Bring the feet forwards near the hands, rise and make a small vertical jump. Land with soft knees before repeating. The plank stage uses straight arms throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Four side-view panels: crouch with hands planted, high plank, feet returned forwards and vertical jump.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
exercises.summary: Driving the knees to the chest from a high plank. Cardio plus core and shoulders.
key_points: Shoulders over the hands
Drive the knees to the chest one at a time
Keep the hips level and low
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank with hands beneath the shoulders and legs extended. Draw the right knee forwards towards the chest while the left leg remains extended. Return the right foot and bring the left knee forwards. Continue alternating while keeping the shoulders above the hands and hips relatively level.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing one knee drawn beneath the chest and the opposite leg extended backwards.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.summary: Lowering and pushing the body up from a plank. Builds the chest, shoulders, triceps and core.
key_points: Body straight from head to heels
Elbows angled back, not flared wide
Chest and hips move together
exercises.movement: Begin in a high plank with hands slightly wider than the shoulders and the body aligned from head to heels. Bend the elbows diagonally backwards, lowering the chest towards the floor while the shoulders and hips descend together. Push through the palms to return to straight arms. Keep the abdomen engaged throughout.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the high-plank start and lowered position, with elbows angled backwards and the body remaining aligned.

exercises.name: Inchworm walkout
exercises.summary: Walking the hands out to a plank and back. A warm-up for the hamstrings, shoulders and core.
key_points: Hinge and place the hands down
Walk the hands out to a plank
Walk the hands back and stand tall
exercises.movement: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Soften the knees, fold forwards at the hips and place the hands on the floor. Keep the feet in place while walking the hands forwards until you reach a high plank. Walk the hands back towards the feet and return to standing.
exercises.image_cue: Three side-view panels showing the forward fold, hands travelling away from the feet and the final high plank.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
exercises.summary: Crawling on hands and feet with the knees hovering. Works the shoulders, core and coordination.
key_points: Knees hover just off the floor
Move the opposite hand and foot together
Small steps with a flat back
exercises.movement: Begin on hands and knees, with hands beneath shoulders and knees beneath hips. Tuck the toes and lift the knees a few centimetres off the floor. Move the right hand and left foot forwards together, then the left hand and right foot. Use small steps, keeping the back approximately level and knees hovering.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing bent knees hovering above the floor and opposite hand-foot pairs moving forwards.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.summary: Lying down, twisting elbow towards the opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
key_points: Hands light on the head: don't pull the neck
Turn the shoulder towards the opposite knee
Slow and controlled, extending the other leg
exercises.movement: Lie on your back with fingertips lightly touching the sides of the head and knees lifted. Raise the shoulder blades slightly. Rotate the rib cage to bring the right shoulder towards the left knee while extending the right leg away. Return through the centre and change sides. Move slowly enough to control the torso, keeping the hands light against the head.
exercises.image_cue: Elevated three-quarter view showing one knee bent towards the opposite shoulder while the other leg extends away from the body.

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
exercises.summary: Holding a glute bridge while lifting one foot at a time. Works the glutes and core stability.
key_points: Lift the hips into a bridge
Lift one foot a little at a time
Keep the hips level: no dropping
exercises.movement: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat. Lift the hips into a bridge, forming a sloping line from shoulders through hips to knees. Maintain this position while lifting one foot a short distance off the floor, keeping its knee bent. Replace it and lift the other foot, keeping the pelvis level.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing a raised bridge with both feet grounded, followed by the same bridge with one bent leg lifted.

sources.title: ACE - Three core moves to improve running form

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.summary: Lying on the back, reaching opposite arm and leg away. Teaches core control and protects the lower back.
key_points: Lower back stays gently pressed to the floor
Reach the opposite arm and leg away slowly
Stop before the back arches
exercises.movement: Lie on your back with arms pointing towards the ceiling, thighs vertical and knees bent to approximately 90 degrees. Slowly reach the right arm overhead while extending the left leg away from the body. Stop before the lower back begins to arch. Return to the start and switch to the left arm and right leg.
exercises.image_cue: Elevated three-quarter view showing the bent-knee starting position and an opposite arm-leg extension, with the unused arm vertical and unused knee bent.

exercises.name: Bird-dog
exercises.summary: Reaching opposite arm and leg on hands and knees. Builds core stability and balance.
key_points: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips
Reach the opposite arm and leg long
Keep the hips level; don't arch
exercises.movement: Begin on hands and knees, with hands beneath shoulders and knees beneath hips. Extend the right arm forwards and the left leg backwards until both are approximately level with the torso. Keep the pelvis level and avoid arching the back. Return the hand and knee to the floor, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing one arm reaching forwards and the opposite leg extending backwards, with the other hand and knee supporting the body.

exercises.name: Side-plank hip lift
exercises.summary: Lifting the hips from a forearm side plank. Works the obliques and side of the hips.
key_points: Elbow under the shoulder
Lift the hips into a straight line
Chest faces sideways; lower and lift with control
exercises.movement: Lie on the right side with the right elbow beneath the shoulder and legs extended, with feet stacked or slightly staggered. Press through the forearm and feet to lift the hips until the shoulders, hips and ankles align. Lower the hips a small distance, then lift back to alignment. Keep the chest facing sideways and repeat on the other side.
exercises.image_cue: View facing the athlete's chest, showing the supporting forearm on the mat and two positions: hips slightly lowered, then the body aligned in a side plank.

sources.title: ACE - Three core moves to improve running form

exercises.name: Air squat
exercises.summary: A bodyweight squat. Builds the legs and glutes and warms up the hips and knees.
key_points: Hips back, chest up
Knees follow the toes, heels down
Drive up through the whole foot
exercises.movement: Stand with the feet about shoulder-width apart and the toes turned out slightly. Push the hips backwards and bend the knees to lower, keeping the chest lifted and the heels on the floor; the arms can reach forwards for balance. Lower as far as you can keep the back steady and the knees tracking over the toes. Drive through the whole foot to stand tall again.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a tall standing start and the bottom of the squat, with the hips back, the heels down and the arms reaching forwards.

exercises.name: Bodyweight lunge
exercises.summary: Stepping forwards into a lunge with no weights. Works the legs, glutes and balance.
key_points: Long step; both knees bend
Front knee over the ankle, chest lifted
Push back through the front heel
exercises.movement: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart. Take a long step forwards and lower until both knees are bent, with the back knee just above the floor and the front knee over the ankle. Keep the chest lifted and the weight through the front heel. Push back to the start and alternate legs.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing a standing start and the bottom of the lunge, with the front shin upright and the back knee just above the floor.

exercises.name: High plank hold
exercises.summary: Holding a straight-arm plank. Builds the core and shoulders.
key_points: Hands under the shoulders, body in a straight line
Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes
Hips don't sag or lift; breathe steadily
exercises.movement: Place the hands beneath the shoulders and step the feet back so the body forms a straight line from head to heels. Press the floor away, brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes so the hips neither sag nor lift. Breathe steadily and hold for the set time. Lower the knees to the mat to rest.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the arms straight beneath the shoulders and a straight line from the head through the hips to the heels.

exercises.name: Jumping jack
exercises.summary: Jumping the feet out and in with the arms going up and down. A classic cardio warm-up.
key_points: Jump the feet out as the arms go up
Land softly on the balls of the feet
Steady rhythm
exercises.movement: Stand with the feet together and the arms by the sides. Jump the feet out wider than the hips while sweeping the arms out and overhead. Jump the feet back together as the arms return to the sides. Land softly on the balls of the feet and keep a steady rhythm.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing the feet together with the arms down, and the feet wide with the arms overhead.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.summary: Running on the spot with the knees up high. Gets the heart rate up fast.
key_points: Knees up towards hip height
Light, quick feet
Stay tall: don't lean back
exercises.movement: Stand tall and run on the spot, driving one knee up towards hip height at a time. Land lightly on the balls of the feet and swing the arms in time with the legs. Keep the chest lifted and avoid leaning back. Slow the pace or march if you need to reduce the impact.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing one knee driven up to hip height with the opposite arm forwards.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.summary: Rising onto the toes with no weights. Strengthens the calves and ankles.
key_points: Tall posture; hold a wall for balance if needed
Rise high and pause
Lower the heels slowly
exercises.movement: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart, holding a wall or rail lightly for balance if needed. Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as you can, pause briefly, then lower the heels slowly to the floor. Keep the knees straight but not locked and the weight over the big toes.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the heels on the floor, then raised high with the weight on the balls of the feet.

exercises.name: Bench tricep dip
exercises.summary: Lowering and pushing up from a bench behind you. Works the triceps.
key_points: Use a stable bench or box
Bend the elbows straight back, back close to the bench
Stop before the shoulders strain
exercises.movement: Sit on the edge of a stable bench or box with the hands beside the hips, fingers facing forwards. Slide the hips off the edge with the knees bent and the feet flat. Bend the elbows straight backwards to lower the hips, keeping the back close to the bench, then press through the hands to straighten the arms. Stop before the shoulders feel strained; straighter legs make it harder.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the hands on the bench edge and the hips lowered in front of it with the elbows bent backwards, then the arms straight.

exercises.name: Plank shoulder tap
exercises.summary: Tapping each shoulder from a high plank. Works the core and shoulder stability.
key_points: Feet wide, hands under the shoulders
Tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time
Keep the hips still
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank with the hands beneath the shoulders and the feet hip-width apart or wider. Brace the stomach and squeeze the glutes. Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder, place it back down and repeat on the other side. Keep the hips as still and level as you can; widen the feet to make it easier.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing a high plank, then one hand lifted to touch the opposite shoulder with the hips level.

exercises.name: Hollow hold to rock
exercises.summary: Holding a hollow body shape and rocking in it. A tough exercise for the deep abs.
key_points: Lower back stays pressed into the mat
Arms and legs long, shoulders off the floor
Rock from the upper back to the hips without bending
exercises.movement: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the mat and lift the shoulders and legs off the floor, arms reaching long, so the body makes a shallow banana shape. Hold this position, then keep the same shape and rock gently forwards and back. If the lower back lifts, bend the knees or raise the legs higher.
exercises.image_cue: Side view showing the hollow hold with shoulders and legs lifted and arms long, then rocked up onto the hips with arms reaching forwards.

exercises.name: V-sit flutter twist
exercises.summary: Flutter kicks and twists from a V-sit. Works the abs, obliques and hip flexors.
key_points: Sit tall and lean back slightly; feet off the floor
Small, quick kicks with the legs
Turn the chest side to side, not just the arms
exercises.movement: Sit on the mat, lean back slightly with a long spine and lift both feet off the floor. Flutter the legs with small up-and-down kicks while you rotate the chest and hands from side to side. Keep the stomach braced and breathe steadily; put the hands down behind you to make it easier.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a V-sit with feet lifted and hands supporting, then the torso rotated to one side with the legs fluttering.

exercises.name: Forearm plank hip dip
exercises.summary: Rotating the hips side to side from a forearm plank. Works the obliques and core.
key_points: Elbows under the shoulders, body in a straight line
Rotate the hips to lower one side towards the floor
Move slowly from side to side; keep the shoulders still
exercises.movement: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under the shoulders and feet together. Brace the stomach and slowly rotate the hips to dip one hip towards the floor, return through the middle and dip to the other side. Keep the shoulders steady over the elbows and don't let the hips sag.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a straight plank, then the hips rotated to dip one side towards the floor.

exercises.name: Cross-body mountain climber
exercises.summary: Driving each knee across to the opposite elbow from a plank. Cardio plus obliques.
key_points: Shoulders over the hands, body straight
Drive each knee towards the opposite elbow
Keep the hips low and level
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders. Drive the right knee across the body towards the left elbow, return it, then drive the left knee towards the right elbow. Keep alternating at a steady pace with the hips low and the shoulders over the hands.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a high plank, then one knee driven across the body towards the opposite elbow.

exercises.name: Push-up to shoulder tap
exercises.summary: A push-up followed by a tap on each shoulder. Works the chest, arms and core stability.
key_points: Body straight from head to heels
Do a push-up, then tap each shoulder
Feet wide to keep the hips still during the taps
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the feet hip-width apart or wider. Do one push-up, keeping the body straight. At the top, tap the right hand to the left shoulder, then the left hand to the right shoulder, keeping the hips still. Drop the knees for the push-up to make it easier.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing the high plank, then one hand lifted to tap the opposite shoulder with the hips level.

exercises.name: Bodyweight lateral lunge
exercises.summary: A side-step lunge with no weights. Works the inner thighs, glutes and hip mobility.
key_points: Wide step to the side; sit the hips back
Bent knee over the toes, other leg straight
Chest lifted; push off the bent leg to return
exercises.movement: Stand tall with the feet together and the hands at the chest. Take a wide step to one side, push the hips back and bend that knee while keeping the other leg straight and both feet flat. Push through the bent leg to return to standing and alternate sides.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing a wide side lunge with one knee bent and the other leg straight, then standing tall with feet together.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge to knee drive
exercises.summary: A backward lunge finishing with a knee lift, no weights. Works the legs, glutes and balance.
key_points: Step back and lower the back knee towards the floor
Drive up and lift that knee to hip height
Swing the arms like running; stay tall
exercises.movement: Stand tall. Step one foot back and lower into a lunge until the back knee is just above the floor, keeping the front knee over the ankle. Push through the front foot to stand and drive the back knee up to hip height, swinging the opposite arm forwards. Lower the foot straight into the next lunge, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bottom of the reverse lunge, then standing on one leg with the other knee driven up to hip height.

exercises.name: Plank jack to pike
exercises.summary: A plank jack followed by lifting the hips into a pike. Cardio plus core and shoulders.
key_points: Jump the feet out and in from a high plank
Then lift the hips up into a pike
Shoulders stay over the hands
exercises.movement: Start in a high plank with the feet together. Jump the feet out wide and back in, like a jumping jack, then lift the hips up and back into a pike, keeping the legs straight and the hands still. Lower back to the plank and repeat. Step the feet instead of jumping to make it easier.
exercises.image_cue: Front three-quarter view showing a high plank, then the hips lifted high into a pike with straight legs.

exercises.name: Bird-dog crunch
exercises.summary: Reaching opposite arm and leg, then crunching them together. Works core stability and the abs.
key_points: Reach the opposite arm and leg long, back flat
Draw the elbow and knee in under the body
Move slowly and keep the hips level
exercises.movement: Begin on hands and knees with the hands under the shoulders and the knees under the hips. Reach one arm forwards and the opposite leg back until both are level with the body. Then bring the elbow and knee in to meet under the stomach, rounding the back slightly. Reach out again; complete the set, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Side three-quarter view showing the bird-dog reach with opposite arm and leg extended, then the elbow and knee drawn together under the body.

exercises.name: Side plank hip dip with reach
exercises.summary: Dipping and lifting the hips in a side plank while reaching up. Works the obliques and shoulders.
key_points: Hand under the shoulder, body in a straight line
Dip the hips towards the floor, then lift them high
Reach the top arm to the ceiling as the hips lift
exercises.movement: Start in a side plank on a straight arm with the hand under the shoulder and the feet stacked. Lower the hips a little towards the floor, then lift them back up into a straight line while reaching the top arm to the ceiling. Keep the chest facing forwards. Bend the bottom knee to make it easier, then change sides.
exercises.image_cue: Front view showing a side plank on one straight arm, then the hips lifted with the top arm reaching to the ceiling.
